fichas.title: Theatres: Auditorium
fichas.summary: Design guidance for theatre auditoriums covers seating layout, audience floor area, aisle and exit provision, wheelchair-accessible seats, acoustic volume, viewing angles, auditorium proportions and traditional auditorium geometry. Applicable Places of Assembly Regulations vary by state; the text notes their application from 200 spectators.
